rationale: The agent authenticated the user correctly via full name + zip and used read-only tools to locate the order and product variants. It obtained explicit confirmation before making order-changing writes. However, it then executed the item modification first despite warning that no further changes would be allowed afterward, which predictably blocked the requested address update. This sequencing error prevented completion of the user’s full request (speaker change plus address change). Additionally, the agent stated that the user "received a small refund" without tool evidence; given the order is pending, this is likely an unsupported assumption (the system may simply adjust the authorization rather than issue a refund). Because the agent failed to complete the requested address update and made an unsupported claim about a refund, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
